signature.name: VTask.pi
signature.type: {ι : Type u_1} -> {R : Type u_2} -> {S : ι → Type u_3} -> [CommSemiring R] -> [(i : ι) → Semiring (S i)] -> [(i : ι) → Algebra R (S i)] -> (s : Set ι) -> (t : (i : ι) → Subalgebra R (S i)) -> Subalgebra R ((i : ι) → S i)

conventions.statement: When the active index set is empty, every element of the product belongs to VTask.pi ∅ t, making it the full product subalgebra regardless of t.
conventions.note: Design choice: indices outside s impose no constraint.

conventions.statement: For any index i not in s, the subalgebra t i is ignored; there is no constraint on the i-th coordinate of elements in VTask.pi s t.
conventions.note: Only active indices (those in s) restrict membership.

facts.statement: ∀ {ι : Type*} {R : Type*} {S : ι → Type*} [CommSemiring R] [∀ i, Semiring (S i)] [∀ i, Algebra R (S i)] (t : (i : ι) → Subalgebra R (S i)) (f : Π i, S i), f ∈ VTask.pi Set.univ t ↔ ∀ i, f i ∈ t i
